sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Bạn có thể gọi bác sĩ được không? asks someone to do one helpful action for you. Use it for call a doctor when pointing, showing your phone, or giving a document will make the request easy to understand.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Say Bạn có thể gọi bác sĩ được không? once, then make the task visible with your symptom note, medicine box, body area, photo, or translated note. The phrase is doing one job: getting a clear answer about call a doctor.
